papers.title: A Three‐Qubit Ising Hamiltonian For High‐Efficiency Quantum Energy Teleportation on Superconducting Hardware

conclusion.zh: 三比特 Ising 协议比较 SIMO 与 MISO。最新预印本摘要明确：保留接收端间耦合后，SIMO 的输出/输入约为 8–10%；MISO 扣除直接沉积到接收端的能量后约为 34–42%。
conclusion.en: A three-qubit Ising protocol compares SIMO and MISO. The latest preprint abstract states that, with receiver–receiver coupling retained, SIMO output/input is about 8–10%; for MISO, after subtracting energy deposited directly at the receivers, it is about 34–42%.

limit.zh: 这些是特定哈密顿量和记账下的结果。论文不同版本有明显修订；比例据 arXiv 最新摘要，不能拿旧版高效率数字作普适上界。
limit.en: These results depend on the specific Hamiltonian and accounting convention. Versions differ substantially; the ratios follow the latest arXiv abstract, and older high-efficiency figures cannot be treated as universal bounds.

papers.title: Thermal screening and critical scaling of quantum energy teleportation in a harmonic chain

conclusion.zh: 谐振子链的高斯测量与反馈可用热二点函数描述。固定有限温度下，远距离输出指数衰减；先取热力学极限再取零温的临界情形给出 d⁻⁴ 渐近律。p 压缩提高前因子，q 压缩降低前因子。
conclusion.en: Gaussian measurement and feedback in an oscillator chain can be described by thermal two-point functions. At fixed finite temperature, long-distance output decays exponentially; in the critical case, taking the thermodynamic limit before the zero-temperature limit gives a d⁻⁴ asymptotic law. p squeezing increases the prefactor, while q squeezing decreases it.

limit.zh: 温度、极限次序、测量方式必须固定；压缩改变振幅并不自动改变远距离指数。
limit.en: Temperature, order of limits and measurement scheme must be fixed; changing the amplitude by squeezing does not automatically change the long-distance exponent.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation on mixed steady states prepared by equilibrium and nonequilibrium environments

conclusion.zh: 在与热库或非平衡环境耦合的两比特混合稳态中研究 QET。输出与稳态本征态占据有关；温差、化学势差和失谐可以在部分参数区域提高输出。
conclusion.en: QET is studied in two-qubit mixed steady states coupled to thermal baths or nonequilibrium environments. Output depends on steady-state eigenstate populations; temperature differences, chemical-potential differences and detuning can improve output in some parameter regions.

limit.zh: 环境供能和稳态制备应纳入成本；非平衡环境并非在所有参数下都更优。
limit.en: Energy supplied by the environment and steady-state preparation must enter the cost accounting; a nonequilibrium environment is not better for all parameters.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation across a lattice and the continuum

conclusion.zh: 比较 massive Thirring/sine–Gordon 连续场与格点 QET。常规格点协议受 U(1) 选择定则限制，不能直接访问连续理论的中性流扇区；新中性流协议恢复粗粒化流关联信号，弱测量输出随测量强度平方缩放。
conclusion.en: Compares continuum massive Thirring/sine–Gordon theories with lattice QET. U(1) selection rules restrict conventional lattice protocols, preventing direct access to the neutral-current sector of the continuum theory; a new neutral-current protocol recovers coarse-grained current-correlation signals, with weak-measurement output scaling quadratically in measurement strength.

limit.zh: 说明关联存在还不够，测量与控制能访问哪个对称扇区同样关键。
limit.en: The existence of correlations is insufficient: the symmetry sectors accessible to measurement and control also matter.

papers.title: Scalable repeater architecture for long-range quantum energy teleportation in gapped systems

conclusion.zh: 对有隙体系提出分层纠缠生成、纯化和交换的中继方案。直接长程全局策略所需资源呈指数增长；分层架构在论文噪声模型下把资源需求改善为多项式尺度。
conclusion.en: Proposes a relay scheme for gapped systems using hierarchical entanglement generation, purification and swapping. Direct long-range global strategies require exponentially growing resources; the hierarchical architecture improves resource requirements to polynomial scaling under the paper’s noise model.

limit.zh: 改善的是资源复杂度，不是证明网络整体净产能；中继、纠缠重建和成功概率仍需计入。
limit.en: The improvement concerns resource complexity, rather than proof of net energy production by the whole network; relays, entanglement rebuilding and success probabilities still require accounting.

papers.title: On Identification of Heat and Work in Quantum Many-Body Systems with Local Operations and Classical Communication

conclusion.zh: 提出用 LOCC/daemonic ergotropy 区分多体系统中的热与功：优化后可提取部分定义为功，未优化而剩余的不可控部分定义为热，并在 Kitaev 链讨论有效 Clausius 关系。
conclusion.en: Proposes using LOCC/daemonic ergotropy to distinguish heat from work in many-body systems: the optimized extractable part is defined as work, and the remaining uncontrolled part as heat. An effective Clausius relation is discussed for a Kitaev chain.

limit.zh: 这是预印本提出的操作性定义，尚不能写成热与功的唯一公认划分。
limit.en: This is an operational definition proposed in a preprint, not the uniquely accepted division between heat and work.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation in strong-field driven atomic systems

conclusion.zh: 提出强场驱动原子 QET。驱动重塑 Floquet 关联动力学，增加可提取负局域能量的同步时间窗口，从而提高重复率和功率；单次提取仍受相互作用生成的关联尺度限制。
conclusion.en: Proposes strong-field-driven atomic QET. Driving reshapes Floquet correlation dynamics and broadens synchronized time windows for extracting negative local energy, increasing repetition rate and power; single-shot extraction remains limited by the correlation scale generated by interactions.

limit.zh: 理论原子平台方案，尚非实验实现；应区分单次能量、重复率、驱动功和净功率。
limit.en: A theoretical atomic-platform proposal, not an experimental realization; single-shot energy, repetition rate, driving work and net power must be distinguished.

affiliationNote.zh: 出版商仅列 Houston, USA，未列研究机构；不能沿用该作者其他预印本的 UCLA 署名。
affiliationNote.en: The publisher lists only Houston, USA, with no research institution; UCLA affiliations from the author’s other preprints cannot be carried over.

papers.title: Nontrivial bounds on extractable energy in quantum energy teleportation for gapped manybody systems with a unique ground state

conclusion.zh: 对有限程、唯一有隙基态多体体系，在受限局域协议和正则性条件下推导随距离指数衰减的可提取能量约束。
conclusion.en: Derives distance-dependent, exponentially decaying bounds on extractable energy for many-body systems with finite-range interactions and a unique gapped ground state, under restricted local protocols and regularity conditions.

limit.zh: 常数依赖模型、能隙和操作约束。不能推广到闭隙临界体系或任意资源辅助协议；精确不等式应以正文定理为准。
limit.en: Constants depend on the model, gap and operation constraints. The result cannot be extended to gapless critical systems or arbitrary resource-assisted protocols; exact inequalities should be checked against the theorems in the paper.

papers.title: Quantum key distribution by quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 提出借助 QET 的密钥分发框架，分析经典/量子噪声与多方协议，利用诚实操作和能量测量构造安全判别。
conclusion.en: Proposes a QET-assisted key-distribution framework, analyzing classical/quantum noise and multipartite protocols, with security tests based on honest operations and energy measurements.

limit.zh: 这是协议与安全分析；仍需区分理论安全假设、器件侧信道与可达到的密钥率。
limit.en: This is a protocol and security analysis; theoretical security assumptions, device side channels and achievable key rates must still be distinguished.

papers.title: Quantum key distribution via charge teleportation

conclusion.zh: 用局域电荷变化的符号编码密钥，比较其对噪声的稳健性与能量方案，并给出 Ising 星形/链模型和量子电路验证。
conclusion.en: Encodes keys in the sign of local charge changes, compares noise robustness with an energy-based scheme, and provides Ising star/chain models and quantum-circuit validation.

limit.zh: 相邻的“电荷传态”研究；不能将电荷激活量直接视为 QET 提取功，密钥率仍有限。
limit.en: An adjacent charge-teleportation study; activated charge cannot be identified directly with work extracted by QET, and the key rate remains limited.

papers.title: Strong Local Passivity in Unconventional Scenarios: A New Protocol for Amplified Quantum Energy Teleportation

conclusion.zh: 证明 SLP 可以出现在非基态、不同测量约束及更广关联结构中；提出局域有效哈密顿量方法求接收端最优提取，并在量子硬件比较放宽条件的新协议。
conclusion.en: Shows that SLP can occur beyond ground states, under different measurement constraints and in broader correlation structures. A local effective-Hamiltonian method optimizes extraction at the receiver; quantum hardware compares new protocols with relaxed conditions.

limit.zh: 约 7.2 倍增强是论文基准模型结果。放宽初态与操作条件后，必须重新检查初始 SLP、直接能量注入及总成本。
limit.en: The approximately 7.2-fold enhancement is a result for the paper’s benchmark model. Relaxing initial-state and operation conditions requires rechecking initial SLP, direct energy injection and total costs.

papers.title: A review of applications of quantum energy teleportation: from experimental tests to thermodynamics and spacetime engineering

conclusion.zh: 综述 QET 的理论基础、NMR/超导验证、量子热力学、冷却和负能量/时空研究，整理不同平台与应用。
conclusion.en: Reviews the theoretical foundations of QET, NMR/superconducting validation, quantum thermodynamics, cooling, and negative-energy/spacetime studies, organizing platforms and applications.

limit.zh: 综述用于定位文献和比较证据层级，不能视为一项独立实验或新定理。
limit.en: A review helps locate literature and compare evidence levels; it is not an independent experiment or a new theorem.

papers.title: Quantum energy in quantum computers: insights from quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 教学式综述 QET 的量子反馈框架、熵和保真度相关约束、discord 资源分析，以及超导量子计算机的实现。
conclusion.en: An educational review of quantum feedback in QET, entropy- and fidelity-related bounds, discord resource analysis, and implementations on superconducting quantum computers.

limit.zh: 属于概述而非新的独立 QET 实验；应用前景不等于已完成的工程功能。
limit.en: An overview rather than a new independent QET experiment; application prospects are not completed engineering capabilities.

papers.title: Nonlocal correlations in quantum energy teleportation: Perspectives from their Majorana representations and information thermodynamics

conclusion.zh: 以 Majorana 表象分析自旋体系。最大总可提取能量与接收端局域自旋能下降由不同非局域关联控制，后者受论文有效信息热力学约束。
conclusion.en: Analyzes spin systems in the Majorana representation. Maximum total extractable energy and the reduction of the receiver’s local spin energy are controlled by different nonlocal correlations; the latter obeys the paper’s effective information-thermodynamic constraint.

limit.zh: 总功、局域裸能量下降与相互作用能变化不是同一个量，适合逐项核对能量分解。
limit.en: Total work, the decrease in local bare energy and changes in interaction energy are different quantities; energy contributions should be checked separately.

papers.title: Entangled Quantum Negative Energy Teleportation as a Probe of Semiclassical Gravity

conclusion.zh: 提出 QET 与 Casimir 限域增强负能量，并估计通过原子钟、干涉和光机械读出半经典曲率的信噪比。
conclusion.en: Proposes enhancing negative energy through QET and Casimir confinement, and estimates signal-to-noise ratios for semiclassical-curvature readout using atomic clocks, interferometry and optomechanics.

limit.zh: 预印本中的曲率探测与作者提出的“Quantum-Curvature Compression Channel（量子—曲率压缩通道）”均属探索性设想；尚无已观测的引力效应，该方案也不意味着超光速旅行。
limit.en: The preprint’s curvature-detection proposal and the author’s speculative “Quantum-Curvature Compression Channel” framework remain exploratory; no gravitational effect has been observed, and the proposal does not imply superluminal travel.

papers.title: Timelike Quantum Energy Teleportation in the Nambu-Jona-Lasinio Model

conclusion.zh: 在 1+1 维 NJL 模型中提出探测器耦合的类时 QET，分析测量、手征凝聚和时间演化对输出的影响，给出格点量子电路验证。
conclusion.en: Proposes detector-coupled timelike QET in a 1+1-dimensional NJL model, analyzing how measurement, the chiral condensate and time evolution affect output, with lattice quantum-circuit validation.

limit.zh: 时间演化可能传播普通能量；应与相同等待时间、无反馈条件下的提取作对照。
limit.en: Time evolution can transport ordinary energy; extraction should be compared with a no-feedback control at the same waiting time.

papers.title: Quantum Energy Teleportation across Multi-Qubit Systems using W-State Entanglement

conclusion.zh: 利用 W 态设计多接收端协议，在三至五比特模拟与 IBM 硬件上报告逐级能量收获。
conclusion.en: Uses W states to design a multi-receiver protocol, reporting successive energy harvesting in three- to five-qubit simulations and on IBM hardware.

limit.zh: 预印本概念验证；必须保留多接收端耦合、制态成本与误差分析，不能直接推出跨实验室能量网络。
limit.en: A preprint proof of concept; receiver–receiver coupling, state-preparation costs and error analysis must be retained. It does not directly establish an inter-laboratory energy network.

authorNote.zh: Mahdy Rahman Chowdhury 与 M. R. C. Mahdy 的同人关系尚未核实，本版保持分开。
authorNote.en: Whether Mahdy Rahman Chowdhury and M. R. C. Mahdy are the same person remains unverified; they are kept separate here.

papers.title: Timelike Quantum Energy Teleportation

conclusion.zh: 提出允许等待时间的类时 QET，用空间和时间关联进行反馈。Ising 模型模拟报告相对常规协议明显提高输出，示例效率约从 3% 到 40%。
conclusion.en: Proposes timelike QET with a waiting time, using spatial and temporal correlations for feedback. Ising-model simulations report substantially higher output than conventional protocols, with example efficiencies rising from about 3% to 40%.

limit.zh: 此数值不是普适上界。正文假设和自然演化对照是判断“反馈增益”的必要条件。
limit.en: These figures are not universal bounds. The paper’s assumptions and natural-evolution controls are necessary for assessing feedback gain.

papers.title: Does Entanglement Correlation in Ground State Guarantee Quantum Energy Teleportation?

conclusion.zh: 在 Toric Code 的所考察投影测量与反馈集合中，虽有基态纠缠仍无法实现正输出。
conclusion.en: In the Toric Code, the examined projection-measurement and feedback operations cannot produce positive output despite ground-state entanglement.

limit.zh: 给出“纠缠不保证指定协议成功”的反例；不等于排除了任意区域大小和所有广义操作。
limit.en: A counterexample to entanglement guaranteeing success for a specified protocol; it does not rule out all region sizes and generalized operations.

papers.title: Quantum Energy Teleportation without Classical Communication

conclusion.zh: 会议论文提出用接收端与辅助比特的弱耦合替代显式经典消息，声称相互作用可以实现所需条件操作。
conclusion.en: A conference paper proposes replacing an explicit classical message with weak coupling between the receiver and an ancillary qubit, claiming that the interaction can implement the required conditional operation.

limit.zh: 这是扩展协议。须审查辅助系统、有效条件控制、初始资源和操作时间；不能由标题推导无通信超光速取能。
limit.en: An extended protocol. Ancillas, effective conditional control, initial resources and operation times require scrutiny; its title does not imply communication-free superluminal energy extraction.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation in phase space quantum mechanics

conclusion.zh: 用 Wigner 函数和星积表达 QET，并以 Husimi Q 函数/Wehrl 熵描述协议中的相干与纠缠消耗；在所研究模型中得到输出与初态纠缠的关系。
conclusion.en: Expresses QET using Wigner functions and star products, and uses Husimi Q functions/Wehrl entropy to describe coherence and entanglement consumption. The studied models yield a relation between output and initial entanglement.

limit.zh: 比例关系依赖模型，不能把纠缠单独当作任意哈密顿量下的能量量尺。
limit.en: The proportionality is model-dependent; entanglement alone is not an energy scale for arbitrary Hamiltonians.

papers.title: Quantum Energy Teleportation versus Information Teleportation

conclusion.zh: 在热纠缠混沌多体/全息例子中发现 QET 与信息传态的性能竞争；进一步对双 qudit 建立非微扰的联合性能约束。
conclusion.en: Finds competition between QET and information-teleportation performance in thermally entangled chaotic many-body/holographic examples, and establishes nonperturbative joint-performance bounds for two qudits.

limit.zh: 这是同一资源和协议设置下的权衡，不是所有量子网络中能量传态与信息传态互相排斥。
limit.en: A trade-off within the same resource and protocol setting, not mutual exclusion of energy and information teleportation in every quantum network.

papers.title: Strong quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 通过关联矩阵分析，将所研究 QET 描述为 steering 过程；定义 QET passive 态并提出 strong QET，展示有量子关联仍可能无法提取，并比较噪声下的策略。
conclusion.en: Describes the studied QET as steering using correlation matrices, defines QET-passive states and proposes strong QET. It shows that quantum correlations can coexist with failure to extract energy, and compares strategies under noise.

limit.zh: 结论依赖采用的状态、哈密顿量和操作集合；不要混淆 QET passive 与任意 CPTP 意义下的 SLP。
limit.en: Results depend on the states, Hamiltonians and allowed operations; QET passivity must not be confused with SLP under arbitrary CPTP maps.

papers.title: Aspects of Quantum Energy Teleportation

conclusion.zh: 比较热态、基态与激发态的 QET。正文最终把无纠缠/discord 的乘积基态协议称为 Quantum Energy Extraction（QEE），并与标准 QET 区分。
conclusion.en: Compares QET in thermal, ground and excited states. The full text ultimately calls the unentangled, discord-free product-ground-state protocol Quantum Energy Extraction (QEE), distinguishing it from standard QET.

limit.zh: 最新摘要仍使用较宽的 QET 措辞；本图谱采用正文区分，避免把广义能量激活写成“标准 QET 不需要关联”的共识。
limit.en: The latest abstract still uses broader QET wording; this atlas follows the distinction in the full text, avoiding a consensus claim that standard QET requires no correlations.

papers.title: Robustness of quantum correlation in quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 在 NJL 等模型中用 discord 追踪测量后混合态的关联；所研究模型里 discord 并未沿整个协议完全消失，并与相变结构相关。
conclusion.en: Uses discord to track correlations in post-measurement mixed states in NJL and other models. Discord does not vanish completely throughout the studied protocols and relates to phase-transition structure.

limit.zh: 测量后剩余 discord 不等于原先接收端可用的关联全部保留，也不能据此证明 discord 是唯一资源。
limit.en: Residual post-measurement discord does not mean that all correlations originally accessible to the receiver survive, nor does it prove that discord is the sole resource.

papers.title: The role of quantum resources in quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 分析量子资源对 QET 输出效率的影响，给出最小 QET 模型的必要充分条件，并通过电路、Gibbs 态及自旋链数值验证。
conclusion.en: Analyzes how quantum resources affect QET efficiency, gives necessary and sufficient conditions for a minimal QET model, and validates them with circuits, Gibbs states and spin-chain numerics.

limit.zh: 必要充分条件的作用域是论文定义的最小模型，不能直接推广成通用多体资源判据。
limit.en: The conditions apply to the paper’s minimal model; they cannot directly become a universal many-body resource criterion.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation via random bi-partitioning in N-qubit systems

conclusion.zh: 研究 N 比特随机二分协议；给定模型中，增加输入比特可提高输出，N−1 个输入/一个输出的效率较高，效率与纠缠随耦合比增加后趋于平台。
conclusion.en: Studies N-qubit random bipartition protocols. In the given model, more input qubits can increase output; N−1 inputs and one output yield higher efficiency, while efficiency and entanglement rise with the coupling ratio and then plateau.

limit.zh: 属于模型内的数值趋势，不能推出增加粒子数总能提高 QET。
limit.en: A numerical trend within the model, not proof that adding particles always improves QET.

papers.title: Extracting and Storing Energy From a Quasi-Vacuum on a Quantum Computer

conclusion.zh: 增设储能比特，将原本由经典设备吸收的输出存入量子寄存器，并在 IBM 超导量子计算机上报告验证。
conclusion.en: Adds an energy-storage qubit to store output in a quantum register instead of a classical device, reporting validation on an IBM superconducting quantum computer.

limit.zh: 研究的是寄存器能量转移/储存的概念验证；完整净功需包含制态、辅助比特和控制成本。
limit.en: A proof of concept for register energy transfer/storage; complete net work must include state preparation, ancillas and control costs.

papers.title: Upper Bound on Locally Extractable Energy from Entangled Pure State under Feedback Control

conclusion.zh: 对纠缠纯态和局域哈密顿量建立有效信息热力学，给出局域反馈可提取能量上界，并给出只依赖初态与局域哈密顿量的更一般界；简单例子可饱和。
conclusion.en: Establishes effective information thermodynamics for entangled pure states and local Hamiltonians, deriving a bound on energy extractable by local feedback and a more general bound depending only on the initial state and local Hamiltonian; simple examples saturate the bounds.

limit.zh: 核心约束针对局域哈密顿量所定义的提取量；有相互作用时不能未经推导就当作完整系统总功上界。
limit.en: The main constraint concerns extraction defined by the local Hamiltonian; with interactions, it is not automatically a bound on total work from the full system.

papers.title: Beyond Energy: Teleporting Current, Charge, and More

conclusion.zh: 把反馈激活推广到任意可观测量，并建立激活量的上界；在手征 Dirac 模型中研究电流、电荷与相图重建。
conclusion.en: Extends feedback activation to arbitrary observables and establishes activation bounds; studies current, charge and phase-diagram reconstruction in a chiral Dirac model.

limit.zh: 输出可观测量不必是能量；这是 QET 思路的推广，属于背景/相邻研究。
limit.en: The output observable need not be energy. This extension of QET ideas is classified as background/adjacent research.

papers.title: Quantum interactive proofs using quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 提出结合态传态与 QET 的交互证明协议，以负局域能量作为验证信号，讨论完备性、可靠性和分布式扩展。
conclusion.en: Proposes an interactive proof combining state teleportation and QET, using negative local energy as a verification signal and discussing completeness, soundness and distributed extensions.

limit.zh: 复杂度与安全结论依赖证明模型及验证条件；小电路可实现信号不等于完整安全系统已实现。
limit.en: Complexity and security conclusions depend on the proof model and verification conditions; realizing a signal in a small circuit does not establish a complete secure system.

papers.title: Strong local passive state in the minimal quantum energy teleportation model

conclusion.zh: 用关联矩阵得到最小 QET 哈密顿量中的一类 SLP 纯态，并讨论混合态/链扩展与 steering；在非基态等广义设定中出现输出/测量输入超过 1。
conclusion.en: Uses correlation matrices to obtain a class of SLP pure states for a minimal QET Hamiltonian, discussing mixed-state/chain extensions and steering. Output/measurement-input ratios above 1 occur in generalized settings, including nonground states.

limit.zh: 超过 1 可消耗初态已有能量。不能套用基态总能非负约束后再称其违反能量守恒。
limit.en: Ratios above 1 can consume energy already present in the initial state. Applying the nonnegative-ground-state-energy constraint to this setting and claiming a violation of energy conservation is invalid.

papers.title: Long‐range quantum energy teleportation and distribution on a hyperbolic quantum network

conclusion.zh: 提出在双曲网络中结合量子态传态与 QET，将局域信息分发给远程节点，以支持多节点和长距离操作。
conclusion.en: Proposes combining quantum-state teleportation with QET in a hyperbolic network, distributing local information to remote nodes to support multinode and long-distance operations.

limit.zh: 地理距离限制转化为预共享纠缠、传态和网络资源成本，并未免除通信时延。
limit.en: Geographic-distance restrictions become costs of preshared entanglement, teleportation and network resources; communication delay is not removed.

papers.title: Exploring Kondo effect by quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 在有 Kondo 杂质耦合的 XXZ 链中，远离杂质的局域测量与反馈输出可重现部分相图结构；峰值与纠缠熵及谱隙变化相关。
conclusion.en: In an XXZ chain coupled to a Kondo impurity, output from local measurement and feedback far from the impurity reproduces parts of the phase diagram; peaks correlate with entanglement entropy and spectral-gap changes.

limit.zh: 属于数值诊断与 Rydberg 平台提案，尚非已验证的通用 Kondo 测量方法。
limit.en: A numerical diagnostic and a Rydberg-platform proposal, not an experimentally validated general Kondo-measurement method.

papers.title: Investigating global and topological orders of states by local measurement and classical communication: Study on SPT phase diagrams by quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 在 Ising、Haldane/AKLT、Kitaev 等模型中，用 QET 输出重现全局/对称保护拓扑相图结构。
conclusion.en: Uses QET output to reproduce global/symmetry-protected topological phase-diagram structure in Ising, Haldane/AKLT, Kitaev and other models.

limit.zh: 可作为模型依赖的相变诊断量，但不存在“任一非局域序都能由单个 QET 信号唯一识别”的定理。
limit.en: A model-dependent phase-transition diagnostic; there is no theorem that every nonlocal order can be uniquely identified by a single QET signal.

papers.title: Demonstration of Quantum Energy Teleportation on Superconducting Quantum Hardware

conclusion.zh: 在 IBM 超导硬件实现最小 QET 电路，观测与理论一致的条件能量降低；测量误差缓解改善一致性。
conclusion.en: Implements a minimal QET circuit on IBM superconducting hardware, observing conditional energy reduction consistent with theory; measurement-error mitigation improves agreement.

limit.zh: 硬件验证的是编码哈密顿量下的协议和能量期望，不是跨空间的宏观功率输送。
limit.en: The hardware validates a protocol and energy expectation under an encoded Hamiltonian, not macroscopic power transmission across space.

papers.title: Quantum Energy Teleportation and Entropy Change due to Feedback Control in One-Dimensional Heisenberg Model

conclusion.zh: 四自旋 Heisenberg 模型中，边界磁场调节纠缠，输出在中间磁场值达最大，并与反馈造成的熵变近似同步。
conclusion.en: In a four-spin Heisenberg model, boundary magnetic fields tune entanglement; output peaks at intermediate fields and approximately tracks feedback-induced entropy changes.

limit.zh: 不是纠缠越大输出越大的普适规律；反馈方向与局域能量结构同样重要。
limit.en: This is not a universal rule that more entanglement gives more output; feedback direction and local energy structure also matter.

papers.title: Criticality of quantum energy teleportation at phase transition points in quantum field theory

conclusion.zh: 在 massive Thirring 场论的格点实现中，QET 输出在部分相变附近出现峰值，并与相图结构关联。
conclusion.en: In a lattice implementation of massive Thirring field theory, QET output peaks near some phase transitions and relates to phase-diagram structure.

limit.zh: 这是所研究场论的模拟结果；输出峰值并非普适相变充要判据。
limit.en: A simulation result for the studied field theory; output peaks are not universal necessary and sufficient criteria for phase transitions.

papers.title: Experimental Activation of Strong Local Passive States with Quantum Information

conclusion.zh: 通过双体 NMR 体系演示 SLP 态的局域能量激活和 QET，展示远端信息配合局域控制可以突破无协作的局域提取限制。
conclusion.en: Demonstrates local-energy activation of SLP states and QET in a bipartite NMR system, showing that remote information with local control can overcome the limits of unassisted local extraction.

limit.zh: 正式发表为 2023 年，预印本为 2022 年；NMR 有效模型和脉冲控制的能量账与宏观真空取能不同。
limit.en: Published in 2023, with a 2022 preprint; energy accounting for NMR effective models and pulse control differs from macroscopic vacuum-energy extraction.

papers.title: Comment on "When the Quantum Energy Teleportation is Observable? "

conclusion.zh: 评论指出“QET 因时间–能量不确定关系而不可观测”的论证误用了不确定关系。
conclusion.en: A comment argues that the claim that QET is unobservable because of time–energy uncertainty misuses the uncertainty relation.

limit.zh: 应与被评论论文配对阅读；不是新的独立 QET 研究结果。
limit.en: Read alongside the criticized paper; this is not a new independent QET research result.

papers.title: When the Quantum Energy Teleportation is Observable?

conclusion.zh: 提出以时间–能量不确定关系估计 QET 可观测性的最小时间条件。
conclusion.en: Proposes estimating a minimum time condition for QET observability from time–energy uncertainty.

limit.zh: Hotta 的同期评论直接反驳其核心论证；该限制不能作为领域共识。
limit.en: Hotta’s contemporaneous comment directly challenges the central argument; this restriction cannot be treated as field consensus.

papers.title: Fundamental Limitations to Local Energy Extraction in Quantum Systems

conclusion.zh: 用半正定规划给出局域一般量子操作无法提取能量的必要充分条件，强化有限温度阈值约束，并在关联足够快衰减时讨论热力学极限。
conclusion.en: Uses semidefinite programming to give necessary and sufficient conditions for energy to be unextractable under general local quantum operations, strengthens finite-temperature threshold bounds, and discusses the thermodynamic limit when correlations decay sufficiently fast.

limit.zh: SLP 依赖状态、哈密顿量、子系统和操作集合；它不是一个只由纠缠数值决定的标签。
limit.en: SLP depends on the state, Hamiltonian, subsystem and allowed operations; it is not a label determined only by an entanglement value.

papers.title: Quantum measurement in two-dimensional conformal field theories: Application to quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 在二维 CFT 中构造准局域测量算符，利用 OPE block/投影结构讨论 QET 可行性与紫外正则化。
conclusion.en: Constructs quasilocal measurement operators in two-dimensional CFT, using OPE blocks/projection structures to discuss QET feasibility and ultraviolet regularization.

limit.zh: 需要控制测量准局域性和 UV 处理；不能把理想投影直接等同于有限成本实验操作。
limit.en: Measurement quasilocality and UV treatment must be controlled; ideal projections are not directly equivalent to finite-cost experimental operations.

papers.title: Transmission and reflection of charge-density wave packets in a quantum Hall edge controlled by a metal gate

conclusion.zh: 在量子 Hall 边缘测量电荷密度波包的门电极激发、传播、透射与反射，并观察非平衡波包路径切换阈值与直流阈值不同。
conclusion.en: Measures gate-electrode excitation, propagation, transmission and reflection of charge-density wave packets at a quantum Hall edge, observing different path-switching thresholds for nonequilibrium wave packets and DC signals.

limit.zh: 2018 年正式发表；这是 QET 候选平台的基础器件实验，不是 QET 本身的完整实现。
limit.en: Published in 2018; a foundational device experiment for a candidate QET platform, not a complete realization of QET itself.

papers.title: Correlation-Enhanced Algorithmic Cooling

conclusion.zh: 提出利用相互作用带来的量子关联改善算法冷却，能够超过假定无内部相互作用的传统冷却限制。
conclusion.en: Proposes using interaction-induced quantum correlations to improve algorithmic cooling beyond traditional limits that assume no internal interactions.

limit.zh: 应比较相同相互作用和热库资源的基线；这是一项与 QET 相邻的冷却研究。
limit.en: The baseline must have the same interactions and bath resources; this is a cooling study adjacent to QET.

papers.title: Engineering negative stress-energy densities with quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 在光–物质相互作用模型中，用 QET 操作制备负局域应力能量密度；所研究协议的尺度行为与 quantum interest 约束相容并达到其尺度。
conclusion.en: Uses QET operations to prepare negative local stress-energy density in a light–matter interaction model; the studied protocol’s scaling is compatible with, and reaches the scaling of, quantum-interest constraints.

limit.zh: 负局域能量不等于负总能量，也不能没有正能补偿和控制成本。
limit.en: Negative local energy does not imply negative total energy; positive-energy compensation and control costs remain necessary.

papers.title: Towards holographic quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 提出 AdS₃/CFT 的简化全息 QET：Alice 局域投影对应激发几何，Bob 的 UV 曲面形变模拟局域操作，并计算提取能量。
conclusion.en: Proposes a simplified holographic QET model in AdS₃/CFT: Alice’s local projection corresponds to an excited geometry, while deformation of Bob’s UV surface simulates a local operation; extracted energy is calculated.

limit.zh: 作者明确为 tentative 模型提案；不是已构造的物理虫洞或时空工程实验。
limit.en: The authors explicitly describe a tentative model proposal, not a physical wormhole or a spacetime-engineering experiment.

papers.title: Asymptotically limitless quantum energy teleportation via qudit probes

conclusion.zh: 用高维 qudit 探针及多项式局域化相互作用，在参数和信息资源随极限增长时构造任意大输出的渐近方案。
conclusion.en: Uses high-dimensional qudit probes and polynomially localized interactions to construct an asymptotic scheme with arbitrarily large output as parameters and information resources grow in the limit.

limit.zh: “无上限”依赖资源同时增长，不否定固定哈密顿量、固定维数或固定成本的界。
limit.en: Unbounded output relies on increasing resources, and does not invalidate bounds at fixed Hamiltonian, dimension or cost.

papers.title: Staged quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 提出对同一自旋对分阶段执行测量/反馈，以改善总吞吐量和效率。
conclusion.en: Proposes staged measurement/feedback on the same spin pair to improve total throughput and efficiency.

limit.zh: 本轮未取得可核验的一手摘要或正文，详细结论与数值暂缺；不用于建立共识。
limit.en: No verifiable primary abstract or full text was obtained in this review; detailed conclusions and numbers remain unavailable, and this record does not support consensus.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation across a three-spin Ising chain in a Gibbs state

conclusion.zh: 对三自旋热 Ising 链优化端点测量和反馈，比较互信息、纠缠和 discord；某些区域即使有 discord，也不能把它视为有效 QET 资源。
conclusion.en: Optimizes endpoint measurements and feedback in a three-spin thermal Ising chain, comparing mutual information, entanglement and discord; discord in some regions cannot be treated as an effective QET resource.

limit.zh: 必须比较协议真正耦合的关联分量，而非仅看关联度量非零。
limit.en: Compare the correlation components actually coupled to the protocol, rather than merely a nonzero correlation measure.

papers.title: Efficiency of quantum energy teleportation within spin-½ particle pairs

conclusion.zh: 把两自旋协议推广到弱测量及具有成对正交纠缠本征态的一类哈密顿量；弱测量提高效率，在最小模型中可加倍，所分析设定中效率不超过 100%。
conclusion.en: Extends two-spin protocols to weak measurements and a class of Hamiltonians with pairwise orthogonal entangled eigenstates. Weak measurements improve efficiency, doubling it in the minimal model; efficiency does not exceed 100% in the analyzed setting.

limit.zh: 这里的效率是接收输出/测量输入；必须同时报告输出大小，弱测量提高比例不保证提高绝对功率。
limit.en: Efficiency here is receiver output/measurement input; output magnitude must also be reported. A better ratio under weak measurement does not guarantee higher absolute power.

papers.title: Strong local passivity in finite quantum systems

conclusion.zh: 定义允许任意局域量子操作的 SLP。非简并纠缠基态附近的一类本征态混合态仍可 SLP；Gibbs 态存在依模型而定的低温区域。
conclusion.en: Defines SLP allowing arbitrary local quantum operations. A class of eigenstate mixtures near a nondegenerate entangled ground state remains SLP; Gibbs states have a model-dependent low-temperature region.

limit.zh: SLP 与通常的全局幺正被动态不同，不能仅用局域幺正稳定性替代一般 CPTP 判定。
limit.en: SLP differs from ordinary global unitary passivity; stability under local unitaries cannot replace a general CPTP test.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation without a limit of distance

conclusion.zh: 用预制压缩真空及两端之间的局域真空区域，绕开原真空协议中随距离下降的输出限制。
conclusion.en: Uses a prepared squeezed vacuum and a local vacuum region between the endpoints to circumvent the distance-dependent output restriction of the original vacuum protocol.

limit.zh: 这是改变资源态后绕开特定限制；压缩制态耗能及距离相关资源不能省略。
limit.en: Changing the resource state circumvents a specific restriction; energy spent preparing the squeezed state and distance-dependent resources cannot be omitted.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation between spin particles in a Gibbs state

conclusion.zh: 在两自旋热态模型中讨论 QET。高温可分态仍能有反馈提取，低温区域存在无协作局域提取禁阻；关联与不同提取策略呈不同温度依赖。
conclusion.en: Studies QET in a two-spin thermal-state model. Separable high-temperature states can still support feedback extraction, while low-temperature regions forbid unassisted local extraction; correlations and extraction strategies have different temperature dependence.

limit.zh: 有限温度反馈输出应与无需 Alice 协作的最佳局域提取比较；不宜把所有热态输出都叫 SLP 激活。
limit.en: Finite-temperature feedback output should be compared with optimal local extraction without Alice’s assistance; not every thermal-state output is SLP activation.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation enabled by thermal discord

conclusion.zh: 研究两自旋热态的 QET，并讨论无纠缠时 thermal discord 的作用。
conclusion.en: Studies QET in two-spin thermal states and discusses the role of thermal discord without entanglement.

limit.zh: 本轮未取得一手摘要/正文，细节待核实；与同年 Gibbs 态期刊论文有主题重叠，独立贡献需再核对。
limit.en: Primary abstracts/full texts were not obtained in this review, so details remain unverified; topical overlap with the same-year Gibbs-state journal paper requires checking the independent contribution.

papers.title: Ground-state-entanglement bound for quantum energy teleportation of general spin-chain models

conclusion.zh: 对一般自旋链基态 QET 建立纠缠熵下界，正输出要求一定基态纠缠，界随提取能量呈正二次关系。
conclusion.en: Establishes a lower bound on entanglement entropy for ground-state QET in general spin chains. Positive output requires some ground-state entanglement, with a positive quadratic bound in extracted energy.

limit.zh: 定理有其模型和基态条件；不应与可分热态的反馈提取混为一谈。
limit.en: The theorem has model and ground-state conditions; it should not be conflated with feedback extraction from separable thermal states.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation in a quantum Hall system

conclusion.zh: 提出量子 Hall 边缘通道的实验 QET 方案，并用合理器件参数估计输出量级。
conclusion.en: Proposes an experimental QET scheme using quantum Hall edge channels and estimates output scales with plausible device parameters.

limit.zh: 是实验设计与估算，不是已经完成的 QET 实验。
limit.en: An experimental design and estimate, not a completed QET experiment.

papers.title: Quantum Energy Teleportation: An Introductory Review

conclusion.zh: 系统介绍自旋链、离子、场论等 QET 协议及负局域能量、纠缠与能量账。
conclusion.en: A systematic introduction to spin-chain, ion and field-theory QET protocols, negative local energy, entanglement and energy accounting.

limit.zh: 入门综述用于梳理假设和文献，不作为新增独立研究结论。
limit.en: An introductory review for organizing assumptions and literature, not an additional independent research result.

papers.title: Passivity breaking of a local vacuum state in a quantum Hall system

conclusion.zh: 提出量子 Hall 边缘真空涨落的局域反馈激活和输出估计。
conclusion.en: Proposes local-feedback activation of quantum Hall edge vacuum fluctuations and estimates output.

limit.zh: 与同一作者 2011 年 Quantum Hall 期刊工作关系密切，是否同一成果的前期版本待核；暂保留为独立记录并标记疑似重叠。
limit.en: Closely related to the same authors’ 2011 quantum Hall journal work; whether this is an earlier version of the same result remains unverified. It is retained separately and marked as potentially overlapping.

overlap.zh: 与 #57 的成果关系待核（相近量子 Hall 方案）
overlap.en: Relation to #57 remains unverified (similar quantum Hall proposals).

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation with a linear harmonic chain

conclusion.zh: 对线性谐振子链用相干态 POVM 和条件位移实现 QET，并建立所消耗纠缠与输出能量的下界关系。
conclusion.en: Implements QET in a linear oscillator chain using a coherent-state POVM and conditional displacements, establishing a lower-bound relation between consumed entanglement and output energy.

limit.zh: 连续变量协议需要同时计算测量注入和位移提取；下界针对论文模型。
limit.en: Both measurement injection and displacement extraction must be calculated in a continuous-variable protocol; the bound applies to the paper’s model.

papers.title: A Brief Introduction to Quantum Energy Teleportation

conclusion.zh: 简要介绍 QET 的测量、经典信息和局域反馈步骤，以及自旋/场论中的物理含义。
conclusion.en: Briefly introduces measurement, classical information and local feedback in QET, and their physical meaning in spin and field-theory settings.

limit.zh: 介绍性预印本，与较长入门综述应区别使用，不作为新的实验记录。
limit.en: An introductory preprint, to be distinguished from the longer introductory review; not a new experimental record.

papers.title: Energy entanglement relation for quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 最小 QET 模型中推导能量–纠缠不等式，把提取输出和资源消耗联系起来。
conclusion.en: Derives energy–entanglement inequalities in a minimal QET model, linking extracted output to resource consumption.

limit.zh: 这些量纲和模型条件不能忽略；不等同于所有状态的“纠缠量×固定系数=能量”。
limit.en: Dimensions and model assumptions cannot be omitted; this is not a universal formula of entanglement times a fixed coefficient equaling energy for all states.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation with an electromagnetic field: discrete versus continuous variables

conclusion.zh: 比较电磁场 QET 的离散比特与连续振子探针，发现测量信息维数影响远距离输出的衰减方式。
conclusion.en: Compares discrete-qubit and continuous-oscillator probes for electromagnetic-field QET, finding that measurement-information dimension affects long-distance output decay.

limit.zh: 改善输出需要不同测量探针和信息资源；不能在未统一资源时比较效率。
limit.en: Improving output requires different probes and information resources; efficiencies cannot be compared without matching resources.

papers.title: Controlled Hawking process by quantum energy teleportation

conclusion.zh: 提出受控 Hawking 过程的思想实验：近视界测量注入正能，条件操作形成负能流，使黑洞质量变化并回收部分投入。
conclusion.en: Proposes a thought experiment for a controlled Hawking process: measurement near the horizon injects positive energy, and a conditional operation produces negative-energy flux, changing the black-hole mass and recovering part of the input.

limit.zh: 是量子场论思想实验；没有免费的黑洞净能提取或实验观测结论。
limit.en: A quantum-field-theory thought experiment, with no free net black-hole energy extraction or experimental observation claimed.

papers.title: Ground-State Entanglement Gives Birth to Quantum Energy Teleportation

conclusion.zh: 章节介绍基态纠缠、局域负能量与 QET 的联系，说明基态整体能量与局域能量可用性不同。
conclusion.en: A chapter introducing links between ground-state entanglement, negative local energy and QET, distinguishing total ground-state energy from local energy availability.

limit.zh: 介绍章节；详细结论参见其关联的原始论文，不视为独立新定理。
limit.en: An introductory chapter; detailed results belong to the associated original papers, not an independent new theorem.

papers.title: Quantum energy teleportation with trapped ions

conclusion.zh: 提出线性离子晶体两端的 QET；经典反馈可在声子到达前完成，接收端从局域涨落提取能量而不先激发中间离子。
conclusion.en: Proposes QET between the ends of a linear ion crystal. Classical feedback can finish before phonons arrive, allowing the receiver to extract energy from local fluctuations without first exciting intermediate ions.

limit.zh: 2009 年是理论实验方案，尚非实际离子 QET 演示。
limit.en: A theoretical experimental proposal from 2009, not an actual ion-QET demonstration.

papers.title: Quantum Energy Teleportation in Spin Chain Systems

conclusion.zh: 建立自旋链 QET：测量注入、经典通信和局域反馈利用基态关联形成局域负能量并给出正输出，同时保持因果性和总能量守恒。
conclusion.en: Establishes spin-chain QET: measurement injection, classical communication and local feedback use ground-state correlations to create negative local energy and positive output while preserving causality and total-energy conservation.

limit.zh: 预印本首发 2008，期刊发表 2009；不要把两个版本计算为两篇。
limit.en: First posted as a preprint in 2008 and published in 2009; the two versions must not be counted as two papers.

papers.title: Quantum Energy Teleportation

conclusion.zh: 会议记录题为 Quantum Energy Teleportation。
conclusion.en: A conference record titled Quantum Energy Teleportation.

limit.zh: 一手正文与贡献者角色未取得；作者元数据含 Alexander Lvovsky，角色待核，本条不参与个人产出统计和共识提炼。
limit.en: Primary text and contributor roles were unavailable. Author metadata includes Alexander Lvovsky, whose role is unverified; this record is excluded from individual output statistics and consensus synthesis.

papers.title: Quantum measurement information as a key to energy extraction from local vacuums

conclusion.zh: 提出量子场局域真空的测量信息辅助提取；接收端条件操作输出正能并在场中产生负能波包。
conclusion.en: Proposes measurement-information-assisted extraction from a local quantum-field vacuum. The receiver’s conditional operation yields positive energy and creates a negative-energy wave packet in the field.

limit.zh: 局域能量可以低于真空基准，但总能量、测量投入和因果性仍受约束。
limit.en: Local energy can fall below the vacuum reference, but total energy, measurement input and causality remain constrained.

papers.title: A protocol for quantum energy distribution

conclusion.zh: 把 QET 推广为多方能量分配：多个接收者利用供应者共享的测量密钥，从自旋链不同位置提取能量。
conclusion.en: Extends QET to multipartite energy distribution: multiple receivers use a supplier’s shared measurement key to extract energy at different spin-chain sites.

question.zh: 什么条件下，远端信息真的能激活局域取能？
question.en: When can remote information actually activate local energy extraction?

zh: 自旋链、谐振子链和量子场存在明确的测量–反馈协议；NMR 与超导平台已有模型层面的实验验证。
经典信息可使接收端选择更好的局域操作；不意味着信号携带了提取的能量，更不意味着超光速。
“存在纠缠”不足以保证指定 QET 协议成功：可访问的关联、对称性、子系统与控制集合都影响输出。
en: Explicit measurement–feedback protocols exist for spin chains, oscillator chains and quantum fields; NMR and superconducting platforms have model-level experimental validation.
Classical information enables the receiver to select a better local operation; it does not mean that the signal carries the extracted energy, or that transmission is superluminal.
Entanglement alone does not guarantee success for a specified QET protocol: accessible correlations, symmetries, subsystems and allowed controls all affect output.

open.zh: 需统一操作定义与基线：标准即时 QET、类时反馈、一般局域能量激活和无需显式消息的扩展不能仅凭同名协议合并。
open.en: Operational definitions and baselines need alignment: standard immediate QET, timelike feedback, general local-energy activation and extensions without explicit messages cannot be grouped solely by a shared protocol name.

question.zh: 哪些关联可被控制利用，关联量是否能预测输出？
question.en: Which correlations can be accessed by control, and can correlation measures predict output?

zh: 基态标准协议中，纠缠与相关函数给出资源约束；若干模型有能量–纠缠界。
混合态需要分析完整条件态和可访问关联；discord、steering 与纠缠分别刻画不同方面，没有公认的单一万能 QET 资源标量。
非零关联不保证正输出；在部分热态模型中，可分态也可以产生协作反馈输出，但须扣除无协作基线。
en: In standard ground-state protocols, entanglement and correlation functions constrain resources; several models have energy–entanglement bounds.

Mixed states require analysis of full conditional states and accessible correlations. Discord, steering and entanglement describe different aspects; no single universally accepted scalar captures all QET resources.
Nonzero correlations do not guarantee positive output. Separable states can yield cooperative feedback output in some thermal models, but the unassisted baseline must be subtracted.

open.zh: Steering 描述很有启发，但其与一般哈密顿量、空间分区及允许操作集合的必要充分关系仍需区分定理和模型证据。
open.en: Steering is an informative description, but necessary and sufficient relations for general Hamiltonians, spatial partitions and allowed operations require distinguishing theorems from model evidence.

question.zh: 上界究竟约束总功、局域能量下降，还是输出/输入比？
question.en: Do bounds constrain total work, local-energy reduction or the output/input ratio?

zh: 从总能量下界为零的基态出发，若测量是唯一能量输入且没有额外外场/初态储能，平均总输出不超过注入能量。
固定资源下的能量界依赖哈密顿量、状态、距离、测量强度和允许控制；没有由所有 QET 协议共享的固定效率数字。
有隙/有限温度体系中的远距离屏蔽，与闭隙临界、压缩资源态和中继协议的改善可以同时成立，因为条件不同。
en: Starting from a ground state with total energy bounded below by zero, average total output cannot exceed injected energy if measurement is the only input and there is no additional external field or stored initial energy.
At fixed resources, energy bounds depend on the Hamiltonian, state, distance, measurement strength and allowed controls; no fixed efficiency figure is shared by every QET protocol.
Long-distance suppression in gapped/finite-temperature systems can coexist with improvements in gapless critical systems, squeezed resource states and relay protocols because the conditions differ.

open.zh: 超 100% 比例常来自分母未包含初态能量或全部输入；完整效率应同时记账制态、测量、驱动、辅助系统与复位，并报告绝对输出。
open.en: Ratios above 100% often omit initial-state energy or some inputs from the denominator. Complete efficiency accounting should include preparation, measurement, driving, ancillas and reset, alongside absolute output.

question.zh: 局域不可提取性是状态性质，还是状态–能量–操作的关系？
question.en: Is local unextractability a state property, or a relation between state, energy and operations?

zh: SLP 是相对于哈密顿量、分区和允许局域一般量子操作的不可提取性；与全局幺正被动性不同。
在一定条件下，非简并纠缠基态邻域以及低温热态具有 SLP；阈值取决于系统。
已有半正定规划必要充分判据及最小模型解析/关联矩阵方法；远端信息可使某些 SLP 态被协作激活。
en: SLP is unextractability relative to a Hamiltonian, partition and allowed general local quantum operations; it differs from global unitary passivity.
Under certain conditions, neighborhoods of nondegenerate entangled ground states and low-temperature thermal states have SLP; thresholds depend on the system.
Necessary and sufficient semidefinite-programming criteria and analytical/correlation-matrix methods for minimal models exist; remote information can cooperatively activate some SLP states.

open.zh: 局域幺正稳定、一般 CPTP 的 SLP、以及某一测量反馈族的 QET passive 态必须严格区分。
open.en: Stability under local unitaries, SLP under general CPTP maps and QET-passive states for a specific measurement–feedback family must be strictly distinguished.

question.zh: 从能量到网络、热力学、场论与其他可观测量。
question.en: From energy to networks, thermodynamics, field theory and other observables.

zh: 已有热态、连续变量、多比特、类时、网络和中继扩展；各自改变了资源或协议的假设。
QET 输出可以探测某些模型中的相图与非局域序，但不是普适或唯一的相变判据。
电荷/电流激活、储能、冷却和信息传态权衡建立了相邻方向；激活的可观测量不总等于可提取功。
en: Extensions to thermal states, continuous variables, multiple qubits, timelike settings, networks and relays exist; each changes resource or protocol assumptions.
QET output can probe phase diagrams and nonlocal order in some models, but is not a universal or unique phase-transition criterion.
Charge/current activation, storage, cooling and information-teleportation trade-offs establish adjacent directions; an activated observable is not always extractable work.

open.zh: 全息与引力设想的证据主要是理论模型或探索性预印本；须与实际硬件 QET 分开判断成熟度。
open.en: Evidence for holographic and gravitational ideas mainly comes from theoretical models or exploratory preprints; their maturity must be assessed separately from hardware QET.

question.zh: 哪些已经实现，哪些仍是平台方案或数值验证？
question.en: What has been realized, and what remains a platform proposal or numerical validation?

zh: 2023 年 NMR 实现 SLP 激活/QET，超导量子硬件实现编码模型的条件取能，是目前基线中的直接实验支柱。
多比特与量子寄存器储能研究继续推进，但预印本结果与正式发表、物理器件功和编码哈密顿量期望必须分别标注。
量子 Hall 波包控制是候选平台准备工作；早期离子和 Hall QET 文章主要是方案，不应计作已完成的 QET 实验。
en: NMR demonstrated SLP activation/QET in 2023, and superconducting quantum hardware demonstrated conditional extraction in encoded models; these are the direct experimental pillars of the current baseline.
Multiqubit and quantum-register storage studies continue, but preprints versus publications, and physical-device work versus encoded-Hamiltonian expectations, must be labeled separately.
Quantum Hall wave-packet control prepares a candidate platform; early ion and Hall QET papers are mainly proposals, not completed QET experiments.

open.zh: 可扩展实验还需解决真实空间分离、自然能量传播对照、完整成本、储能读出、误差与重复循环；功率优势仍需同资源基线验证。
open.en: Scalable experiments still need real spatial separation, controls for natural energy propagation, full costs, storage readout, errors and repeated cycles; power advantages require matched-resource baselines.

notes.zh: 基于此前确认的 70 条文献记录整理，不声称已经穷尽全球 QET 文献。
notes.en: Based on the previously confirmed 70 literature records; this is not claimed to exhaust the global QET literature.

notes.zh: 期刊图按线上正式发表年优先；无线上日期则用出版元数据。预印本与正式发表不重复计为两项成果。
notes.en: Journal statistics prioritize online publication years, using publication metadata when no online date is available. Preprint and published versions are not counted as separate results.

notes.zh: 地图采用每篇论文署名机构，联合署名完整计数；同一成果可计入多家机构，因此机构数不可相加作为论文总数。
notes.en: The map uses affiliations listed in each paper and fully counts joint affiliations. One result may belong to several institutions, so institutional counts cannot be summed into a paper total.

notes.zh: 地图城市级定位，不表示具体实验室坐标；人员归属是历史论文署名，不是现任职证明。
notes.en: Map locations are city-level, not precise laboratory coordinates. People’s affiliations reflect historical papers, not proof of current employment.

notes.zh: 个人 QET 数只计本库 QET主题条目，另列其中期刊条目；综述、背景和评论不计入 QET 数。#68 作者角色待核，不计入个人统计。
notes.en: Individual QET counts include only this catalog’s QET-theme records, with journal records listed separately; reviews, background and comments are excluded. #68 has an unverified author role and is excluded from individual statistics.

notes.zh: 主题允许多标签；共识是本轮基于文献的综合判断，正文细节未核条目不作为共识支撑。
notes.en: Themes allow multiple tags. Consensus is a literature-based synthesis for this review; records with unverified full-text details do not support it.

notes.zh: #59 与 #57 的量子 Hall 成果关系待核；#55 与 #54 的会议/期刊工作贡献重叠需复核。潜在作者别名尚未确认时不合并。
notes.en: The relationship between quantum Hall results #59 and #57 remains unverified; overlapping contributions in conference/journal works #55 and #54 require review. Potential author aliases are not merged without confirmation.
